newsitem.title: CANADA: Centrefund to sell C$75 mln of debentures.
newsitem.headline: Centrefund to sell C$75 mln of debentures.

text.p: Centrefund Realty Corp on Thursday said it reached an agreement with a syndicate of underwriters to issue C$75 million of 7.875 percent subordinated debentures on a "bought deal" basis.
The company said the debentures are convertible into common shares of the company at C$17 per share.

The syndicate, which is lead by RBC Dominion Securities Inc, also includes CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Inc, HSBC James Capel Canada Inc, Nesbitt Burns Inc, and First Marathon Securities Inc. Centrefund said the issue is scheduled to close in early February.
